data.exact_reserve_text: The result, as detailed above, is driven by a general trend of reductions in incurred claims due to favourable settlement of claims, including releases chiefly from Construction Defect contracts. Gross technical provisions have reduced to GBP 87.8m from GBP 96.6m, driven by reductions on the legacy business which is partly offset by the increased IBNR on the live business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Releases of reserves following favourable settlement of construction defect claims (reductions on legacy business).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports favourable prior-year reserve experience in 2015 driven by reductions in incurred claims and releases mainly from construction defect contracts; gross technical provisions fell from GBP 96.6m to GBP 87.8m, principally reflecting releases on legacy business partially offset by increased IBNR on live business. The movement was concentrated in legacy casualty-type business and is attributed to favourable claim settlements and active claims management.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure is stated in the disclosures. The report describes favourable releases and shows a reduction in total gross claims outstanding from GBP 96.644m (opening) to GBP 87.761m (closing) but does not provide a clear gross 'movement in prior years provision' line. The claims development table in the notes is incomplete/partially presented in the PDF extract (contains an aggregate 'Before 2011' column which must be excluded per rules), so a definitive gross prior-year development number could not be calculated. prior_year_development_gbp_m is therefore returned as null. Where narrative quantifies releases it often quotes net amounts; no gross quantified PYD was available.
